input_instruction: Triage the four appliance service requests in `/tmp/lifecycle/board.xlsx` on the second Linux machine using `/tmp/lifecycle/policy.html` on the first. Check the live SmartHome devices, perform only the actions that should happen now, and complete each row's decision and after-state in the workbook.

Simple Calendar Pro has a Morning run event. Please combine that event with /tmp/morning-run/run_rules.xlsx, schedule the bedroom preparation in SmartHome, update the calendar event description, and save /tmp/morning-run/run_confirm.xlsx.

Use the `Guest check-in` Calendar event, the `Maya Patel` contact, and `/tmp/guest-ready/guest_standard.csv` to schedule one active Guest room readiness workflow. The workflow must make every device state listed in the matching standard ready. Send Maya a concise confirmation that identifies the Guest room, the scheduled readiness time, and that the preparation has been scheduled or will be ready at that time.

A new message in Simple SMS Messenger changes the away time. Verify the sender's authorization in Android Contacts, reconcile the request with /tmp/away-change/away_policy.docx, update SmartHome, reply to the sender, and save /tmp/away-change/away_change_register.xlsx.

Markor has a Sleep Setup note. Use it with /tmp/sleep-setup/sleep_capability_policy.pdf, perform the supported SmartHome changes, and record the outcome in a new Markor note named Sleep Setup Outcome.

Use the Sleep block Calendar event, /tmp/quiet-hours/quiet_hours.xlsx, and the current SmartHome workflows to enforce quiet hours. Cancel the conflicting late-washer workflow, keep the compatible bedroom lights-out workflow active, and record both final decisions in Markor as Quiet Hours Audit.md.

Use /tmp/incident-response/incident_response.xlsx with the current SmartHome conditions. Respond to every condition that exceeds its threshold, notify the duty contact from Contacts only about the highest-severity issue, and save /tmp/incident-response/incident_response_filled.xlsx.

The pending Energy Review task and energy_review.xlsx in the Linux shared Energy Review folder describe the rooms to check. Use the current Home status to shut down only eligible rooms, complete the task with the outcome, and save energy_result.xlsx in the same folder.

Simple Calendar Pro has Leave apartment and Return home events. Use /tmp/laundry-plan/laundry_sla.xlsx to schedule the laundry work before I get back, add a Tasks reminder, and save /tmp/laundry-plan/laundry_plan.xlsx.

Simple Calendar Pro has a Video meeting event. Follow noise_policy.pdf in the Linux shared Meeting Noise folder to schedule the required SmartHome quieting before the meeting, without changing the devices early.

A Simple SMS Messenger request asks for guest-room heat. Check Contacts and /tmp/guest-heat/guest_control.xlsx, adjust SmartHome if authorized, reply by SMS, and save /tmp/guest-heat/guest_heat_audit.md for the household authorization log.

Markor has the approval note for the porch-light change. Use /tmp/porch-approval/approval_page.html as the local approval record, update SmartHome, and save the submitted approval receipt as /tmp/porch-approval/approval_submit.html for the porch-light archive.
A Simple SMS Messenger cancellation request came in. Check Contacts and /tmp/away-cancel/cancel_policy.pdf; if the request is not authorized, keep SmartHome unchanged and reply by SMS.

Simple Calendar Pro shows a maintenance window. Use /tmp/maintenance-window/maintenance_order.xlsx to prepare SmartHome at the window start, then save the completion register as /tmp/maintenance-window/maintenance_done.xlsx.
Simple Calendar Pro has an Early Flight event. Use /tmp/flight-prep/flight_prep.docx to set the cross-midnight SmartHome prep and save /tmp/flight-prep/flight_prep_summary.md.
Use /tmp/daily-alerts/daily_thresholds.xlsx and the current SmartHome status to send only the Critical alert to the duty contact in Contacts, then save /tmp/daily-alerts/daily_alerts.xlsx.
Markor has a Study Comfort request. Use /tmp/study-comfort/study_policy.pdf, apply only the supported SmartHome changes, and record the outcome in a new Markor note named Study Comfort Result.

A Simple SMS Messenger request says to turn on the purifier 10 minutes before inspection, but there is no inspection event on the phone. Use /tmp/inspection-check/inspection_requirements.pdf to handle the request and reply by SMS.
Simple Calendar Pro has a Guest window event. Use /tmp/cleaning-review/cleaning_policy.xlsx with SmartHome status, update Tasks, and save /tmp/cleaning-review/cleaning_review.xlsx.
Simple Calendar Pro has a sleep plan, but Markor contains an approved override. Use /tmp/sleep-override/sleep_priority.pdf to update SmartHome and update the calendar description.

The Owner's override is in Simple SMS Messenger, their identity is available in Contacts, and batch_changes.xlsx is in the Linux shared Batch Control folder. Apply only the approved Home rows, reply with what was applied or skipped, and save batch_result.xlsx in the same folder.

Simple Calendar Pro has an Office Commute event. Use commute.xlsx in the Linux shared Morning Commute folder together with the bedroom's current Home state to create only the preparation that is actually needed, then save result.xlsx in the same folder. Leave the bedroom unchanged until the plan begins.

Simple Calendar Pro has several events. Use /tmp/away/rules.docx to choose the first away event, update the SmartHome away workflow, and save a change record for the household automation log at /tmp/away/decision.json using the fields specified in rules.docx.

Simple Calendar Pro has today's Lunch Break. Use /tmp/quiet/nap.xlsx with SmartHome occupancy to set lunch quiet mode, cancel ineligible cleaning, and record the applied and skipped actions in a Markor note named Lunch Quiet Notes.

Simple Calendar Pro has the revised Client Review time. Follow setup.xlsx in the Linux shared Client Review folder to replace the obsolete study preparation plans, add the Client Review room check task at the workbook's check time, and save fix.xlsx in the same folder.

After the `Dinner Guests` event ends, return the living room to the baseline described in `/tmp/guest/restore.docx`. Schedule the restore workflow for the required time, and leave a `Dinner Restore.md` note in Markor with that time and the final light, curtain, purifier, and heater settings.

Simple Calendar Pro has tomorrow's Early Shift. Use /tmp/shift/prep.xlsx to create the cross-midnight SmartHome preparation, add a Tasks item titled Early Shift confirmation at the full confirmation date and time, and save /tmp/shift/summary.xlsx.

The old Project Dinner event is no longer in Simple Calendar Pro. Use /tmp/guest/cleanup.xlsx to locate and cancel the leftover SmartHome reception workflow, then record the cleanup in a Markor note named Guest Cleanup.

Simple Calendar Pro has morning and afternoon work meetings. Use /tmp/work/day-plan.xlsx to create the SmartHome study preparation and midday energy plans, add a Tasks item titled Midday study review at the table's review time, and save /tmp/work/day_result.xlsx.

Please have the living room warmed for the `Homecoming` event. Use its Calendar time, the current SmartHome temperature, and `/tmp/homecoming/heat.xlsx` to choose the applicable lead time and target, then schedule the heating adjustment. Leave a `Homecoming Heat.md` note in Markor with the current reading and matching temperature band, plus the final scheduled time and target.

Simple Calendar Pro has Sleep and Late Movie at the same time. Use /tmp/modes/priority.pdf to resolve the SmartHome mode conflicts and preserve compatible actions. Create a Tasks item titled Mode conflict review due 15 minutes before the events.

Simple SMS Messenger has Morgan's guest-room climate request. Use Android Contacts app and /tmp/access/climate.xlsx to check authorization, update SmartHome, reply by SMS, and save /tmp/access/climate_audit.xlsx.
Simple SMS Messenger has a request to cancel tonight's away mode. Use Android Contacts and /tmp/access/cancel.pdf to decide, reply by SMS, and leave unauthorized SmartHome automation unchanged.

Markor's Guest Evening note has the old rule, while Simple SMS Messenger has a newer owner override. Use Android Contacts and /tmp/guest/priority.docx to replace the SmartHome plan and append the authoritative source and result to Guest Evening.

Use /tmp/alerts/routes.xlsx to route current SmartHome environment exceptions. Notify only the highest-severity owner in Android Contacts app through Simple SMS Messenger, apply allowed mitigation, and save /tmp/alerts/routes_filled.xlsx.

Simple SMS Messenger has an emergency bedroom request. Use Android Contacts app and /tmp/protection/override.xlsx to decide which SmartHome changes are allowed, reply by SMS, and save /tmp/protection/result.xlsx.

Simple SMS Messenger has a vendor request to stop a laundry device. Use Android Contacts app and /tmp/vendor/scope.xlsx to apply only the allowed SmartHome action, reply with a summary, and save /tmp/vendor/audit.xlsx.
Simple SMS Messenger has a family request to restart the dryer. Use Android Contacts and /tmp/laundry/lock.pdf to decide, reply by SMS, and create a Tasks item titled Dryer lock review due at 16:05.
Simple SMS Messenger has a request to cancel kids-room cleaning. Use Android Contacts and /tmp/cleaning/cancel.xlsx to cancel only the matching SmartHome plan and reply by SMS.

Simple SMS Messenger has a request that claims to be from the owner. Use Android Contacts and /tmp/access/identity.pdf to verify the identity, reply by SMS, and leave the protected SmartHome plan unchanged.
Simple SMS Messenger has three household control requests. Use Android Contacts and /tmp/access/batch.xlsx to handle each request and save the decision register in /tmp/access/batch_result.xlsx.
Markor's Tonight Sleep note and Simple Calendar Pro's sleep event are ready. Use /tmp/sleep/standards.xlsx to create the SmartHome bedtime plan and append the actual settings to Tonight Sleep.
Read Markor's Leave Home checklist and /tmp/away/protected.xlsx. Apply only the allowed SmartHome changes and create a Tasks item titled Bedroom light review due at 19:30 for the protected item.
Markor's Movie Night note describes the goal. Use /tmp/movie/fallback.pdf with SmartHome capabilities to set movie mode and append the selected fallback actions to Movie Night.

Markor's Dinner Notes includes tonight's meal end time. Use /tmp/kitchen/air.xlsx and the kitchen SmartHome air reading to schedule post-dinner purification, create a Tasks item titled Kitchen air verification at the calculated verification time, and save /tmp/kitchen/air_result.xlsx.

Use Markor's Room Setup checklist and /tmp/rooms/exact.pdf to determine which requests are supported. Carry out the supported requests, report unsupported or invalid requests as infeasible, and save the results in /tmp/rooms/result.xlsx.

Markor's Accessibility Preferences note and Simple Calendar Pro's study meeting are ready. Use /tmp/accessibility/light.xlsx to create the SmartHome pre-meeting plan and update Markor with the final plan.
Markor's Morning Checklist lists curtain, light, and air goals. Use /tmp/morning/criteria.xlsx with current SmartHome state, do only unfinished items, and update Markor with the result.

Markor's Cleaning Plan lists target areas. Use /tmp/cleaning/restrictions.xlsx with the current SmartHome vacuum state, handle the conflict, and create or update the Tasks app item titled Vacuum recharge review.
Markor's Guest Comfort note uses natural preferences. Use /tmp/comfort/map.xlsx with the current SmartHome guest-room state and apply only the needed setting.
Markor's Night Rules note is old. Use /tmp/night/index.xlsx and /tmp/night/approved.docx to correct the SmartHome night workflow and update Markor with the approved version.

Use /tmp/alerts/duty.xlsx to classify the current SmartHome environment exceptions. Fill the workbook, find the highest-level duty contact in Android Contacts, notify them with Simple SMS Messenger, and save /tmp/alerts/duty_filled.xlsx.

Use /tmp/maintenance/lifecycle.xlsx to review the current SmartHome laundry and vacuum devices. Take the allowed automatic action, create or update only the Tasks app item titled Dryer maintenance follow-up, and save /tmp/maintenance/lifecycle_filled.xlsx.

Use /tmp/laundry/reminders.xlsx and the current SmartHome washer and dryer status to determine the correct reminder, create or update the Tasks app item titled Washer unload reminder, and save /tmp/laundry/reminders_filled.xlsx.
Use /tmp/energy/whitelist.xlsx to check current SmartHome occupancy and running devices. Shut down only non-whitelisted waste and record every decision in Markor's Energy Review note.

Use /tmp/automation/recovery.docx to inspect failed SmartHome workflows. Apply only the allowed recovery, notify the automation owner from Android Contacts app through Simple SMS Messenger, and save /tmp/automation/recovery_report.docx.

Use /tmp/comfort/ranking.xlsx to score the current SmartHome rooms. Fix only the lowest-scoring room with the highest-priority allowed action, create or update the Tasks app item titled Comfort ranking follow-up, and save /tmp/comfort/ranking_filled.xlsx.
Use /tmp/air/shutdown.xlsx with the current SmartHome air readings. Turn off only the purifier that meets the shutdown policy and record every shutdown or keep decision in Markor's Air Shutdown note.

Use /tmp/vacuum/maintenance.xlsx to decide the current SmartHome robot vacuum action. Apply the policy, create or update the Tasks app item titled Vacuum charge check, and save /tmp/vacuum/maintenance_filled.xlsx.

Use /tmp/night/checklist.xlsx to audit current SmartHome bedtime readiness. Automatically fix allowed items, record protected items in Markor's Night Review, and save /tmp/night/checklist_filled.xlsx.

Compare conflicts.xlsx in the Linux shared Automation Conflicts folder with the calendar windows and the active Home plans. Cancel only actual conflicts, update the SmartHome conflict changes task with the decisions, and save conflicts_filled.xlsx in the same folder.

Markor's Laundry Batch note has the clothing type and deadline. Use /tmp/laundry/cycles.xlsx to start the correct SmartHome washer cycle, create or update the Tasks app item titled Delicates washer reminder, and save /tmp/laundry/batch_result.xlsx.

Simple SMS Messenger has a washer cycle change request. Use /tmp/laundry/change.pdf with the current SmartHome washer status, reply to the requester, and create or update the Tasks app item titled Washer change review.

Simple Calendar Pro has Leave for Dinner, and Markor has the fabric note. Use /tmp/dryer/duration.xlsx to choose a legal dryer cycle that finishes before leaving, start SmartHome dryer, update the calendar description, and save /tmp/dryer/result.xlsx.

Simple Calendar Pro has a study video meeting. Use /tmp/dryer/quiet.xlsx to quiet the SmartHome dryer, schedule any allowed restart, create or update the Tasks app item titled Dryer restart confirmation, and save /tmp/dryer/quiet_result.xlsx.

Simple Calendar Pro shows when I will return home. Use /tmp/laundry/pipeline.xlsx and the current SmartHome laundry status to schedule the remaining laundry chain, then record the stage times in the Markor note Laundry Pipeline.

Simple Calendar Pro shows tonight's cleaning request. Use /tmp/vacuum/policy.xlsx and the SmartHome battery status to take the compliant action, create the Tasks app follow-up Vacuum cleaning review, and save /tmp/vacuum/policy_result.xlsx.

Simple Calendar Pro shows a living-room meeting. Use /tmp/vacuum/meeting.xlsx to pause SmartHome cleaning and schedule the allowed resume, then record the pause and resume plan in the Markor note Vacuum Meeting Plan.
Simple SMS Messenger has today's cleaning cancellation. Use /tmp/vacuum/cancel.docx to process the SmartHome robot vacuum, reply with the final status, and save /tmp/vacuum/cancel_result.docx.
Use /tmp/laundry/sla.xlsx with the current SmartHome washer cycle to create the Tasks app reminder Quick washer unload and update Markor's Laundry Log with the cycle timing.

Use /tmp/laundry/humidity.xlsx with SmartHome dryer remaining time and laundry-room humidity. Schedule the required dehumidifier actions, reply in Simple SMS Messenger with the times, and save /tmp/laundry/humidity_result.xlsx.
Simple Calendar Pro shows the updated sleep time. Use /tmp/bedtime/rules.xlsx to replace the old SmartHome bedtime workflow and record the old and new times in the Markor note Bedtime Change.

Simple SMS Messenger says tonight's guest visit was cancelled. Use /tmp/guest/register.xlsx to find the matching SmartHome guest workflow, cancel only that workflow, reply with the result, and save /tmp/guest/cancel_result.xlsx.

Markor's Automation Cleanup note asks for duplicate schedule cleanup. Use /tmp/schedules/register.xlsx to keep the approved revision, update SmartHome, append the cleanup result in Markor, and save /tmp/schedules/register_filled.xlsx.

Simple Calendar Pro shows an overnight sleep event. Use /tmp/quiet/move.xlsx to move the noisy SmartHome workflow to the first allowed time, create the Tasks app record Moved vacuum workflow, and save /tmp/quiet/move_result.xlsx.
Simple Calendar Pro shows Evening Reading. Use /tmp/evening/stages.xlsx to create each SmartHome stage at its own time and list the absolute times in the Markor note Evening Reading Stages.
Simple SMS Messenger has a request to cancel tonight's security routine. Use /tmp/automation/protected.pdf to handle it and reply to the requester.

Use the approved `Climate Update` note on Android and `/tmp/schedules/merge.pdf` to replace the existing living-room AC schedule. Cancel the identified old schedule and create the approved active correction. In Markor, create `Climate correction result.md` and record the old 25 C setting, the new 24 C setting, the 20:00 scheduled time, and that the old schedule was cancelled while the replacement is active or applied.

Simple Calendar Pro shows tonight's guest visit. Use /tmp/cleaning/after-guest.xlsx to move the SmartHome cleaning workflow after the guest buffer, create the Tasks app item After-guest cleaning check, and save /tmp/cleaning/after_guest_result.xlsx.
Use /tmp/automation/repair.xlsx to inspect SmartHome workflow repair candidates. Repair only the approved workflow that is still failed and record every repair decision in Markor's Repair Log.

Markor's Cancel Tonight Cleaning note identifies a cleaning workflow to cancel. Use /tmp/cleaning/audit.xlsx to complete the cancellation audit, append the cancellation result in Markor, and save /tmp/cleaning/audit_filled.xlsx.
Markor's Guest Room Cooling note asks for a specific cooling target. Use /tmp/guest/no-substitute.pdf to handle the request and create the Tasks app item Guest room cooling follow-up.

A family member asks in Simple SMS Messenger to set the living-room light to 30%. Use /tmp/lights/policy.xlsx to check what is allowed, reply to the request, and summarize the available capability in the Markor note Living Room Light Capability.

Simple SMS Messenger has a request to open the bedroom curtain to 140%. Use Curtain Range Reference.pdf in the Linux shared Curtain Requests folder to handle the invalid value, and create a Tasks item named Confirm bedroom curtain percentage for the corrected setting.

Simple Calendar Pro shows a household check that has already started, and Markor asks for a purifier action before that check. Use /tmp/schedule/time-policy.pdf and record the result without backdating the automation in the Markor note Check Prep Result.

Simple SMS Messenger asks to turn off the living-room air conditioner before maintenance starts. Use /tmp/maintenance/time.pdf and the visible Simple Calendar Pro state to decide what can be done, then reply.

Markor's Laundry Change note asks to switch the current washer to quick. Use /tmp/laundry/operation.xlsx to process the request, create the required Tasks follow-up titled Review washer cycle change, and save /tmp/laundry/operation_result.xlsx.

Simple Calendar Pro has a cleaning appointment soon. Use /tmp/vacuum/safety.xlsx to handle the low-battery robot vacuum, create a Tasks reassessment titled Reassess living room cleaning, and save /tmp/vacuum/safety_result.xlsx.

Markor's Clean Kids Room note asks for immediate cleaning. Use /tmp/cleaning/occupancy.pdf and SmartHome occupancy to decide the result, then create the required Tasks follow-up titled Recheck kids room cleaning.

Simple Calendar Pro and Simple SMS Messenger disagree about tonight's guest arrival time. Use Contacts and /tmp/guest/priority.xlsx to choose the valid source, adjust SmartHome, and record the decision in a Markor note named Guest Time Decision.

Use batch.xlsx in the Linux shared Change Batch folder together with the Owner's override in Simple SMS Messenger. Process the mixed Home requests, and record every applied, rejected, or infeasible row in a Markor note named Batch Change Results.

The Approvals folder in the Linux shared directory contains change.html. Match its approved change number with Markor's Change Details note, update only the approved SmartHome item, and save the completed decision page as change_result.html beside the source page.
Use /home/user/alerts/dashboard.html to process only still-active SmartHome alerts, then notify the right contact through Simple SMS Messenger and save /tmp/alerts/dashboard_result.xlsx.

Use cleanup.html in the Linux shared Workflow Cleanup folder and the sleep window in Simple Calendar Pro to cancel only the conflicting active Home workflow. Keep unrelated and completed workflows intact, and save cleanup_result.html in the same folder with the disposition of each reviewed workflow.
Simple SMS Messenger asks to dim the living room. Use /home/user/capability.html to choose the approved fallback, apply it in SmartHome, and reply to the sender.

Use /home/user/maintenance/workorder.html to inspect the listed SmartHome laundry devices, apply the allowed automatic action, create the required Tasks follow-up titled Dryer manual maintenance, and save /tmp/maintenance/workorder_result.html.
Use /home/user/guest.html and Android Contacts to prepare Sam's visit. Create the SmartHome guest workflow and send the confirmation by Simple SMS Messenger.
Simple Calendar Pro has a meeting starting soon. Use /home/user/policies/quiet.html to handle current SmartHome noise sources and summarize every outcome in a Markor note named Meeting Quiet Result.
Use /home/user/repair.html to repair only the approved failed SmartHome workflow and record every repair decision in a Markor note named Workflow Repair Log.
Use /home/user/incidents/incident.html to handle the confirmed laundry incident, check SmartHome washer and dryer, notify the duty contact, and save /tmp/incidents/incident_report.docx.

The Linux shared Change Requests folder contains changes.html, and the Owner's one-row override is in Simple SMS Messenger. Process each request under the page's rules, submit the batch, reply about the override, and save change_result.xlsx in the same folder with one audit row per request.

Tasks app has a laundry work order pointing to /tmp/laundry/care.png. Use /tmp/laundry/cycle-map.xlsx to choose the washer cycle, update SmartHome and the task, and save /tmp/laundry/cycle_result.xlsx.
Use /tmp/rooms/floor.png and Markor's Room Changes note to apply only the allowed room updates, then summarize every outcome in a Markor note named Room Changes Outcome.

The Linux shared Laundry Incident folder contains leak.png and Laundry Leak Response.pdf, and Simple SMS Messenger confirms the alert. Stop only the SmartHome devices required by the response guide, reply with the result, and save the completed incident report as Laundry Leak Report.docx in the same folder.

Prepare the Living room for Sam's visit. Derive the visit time and reply number from Calendar, the requested settings from `/tmp/guest/card.png`, and the mapping and lead-time rule from `/tmp/guest/standards.xlsx`. Schedule one active SmartHome workflow for the preparation. Send Sam a concise confirmation that includes the Living room, the preparation time, and the requested settings.
Use /tmp/cleaning/no-go.png with the nap event in Simple Calendar Pro to resolve any conflicting cleaning plans and summarize the cancellation outcome in a Markor note named Nap Cleaning Audit.

Simple SMS Messenger asks to change the bedroom night workflow. Use Contacts and Bedroom Workflow Access Policy.pdf in the Linux shared Access Review folder to decide whether the sender is authorized, then reply with the decision.

Use matrix.xlsx in the Linux shared Maintenance Matrix folder with the emergency SMS and the sender's Contacts role. Carry out only authorized, supported Home actions, list unresolved items in the Maintenance matrix unresolved items task, and save matrix_result.xlsx in the same folder.

Evening Reading Tracks.csv on the first phone identifies the narration set and duration; the bedroom wind-down request is in Tasks on the second. Apply Reading Wind-down Policy.json from the shared folder, schedule the bedroom scene, and complete the Tasks handoff with the plan.

Mobility Session Tracks.csv on the first phone contains the therapy set’s tempo, and the therapist’s timing request and reply thread are on the second. Use Mobility Session Scene Policy.csv from the shared folder to schedule the study scene and reply with the derived plan.

Use the arrival request in SMS, the matching Contacts entry, the live living-room temperature, and Return Cooling Policy.csv in the shared folder to plan the room for the sender's return. Review Rosa's pet-climate request in SMS, verify the sender's role in Contacts, and apply Pet Heat Response.csv from the shared folder to the live living-room temperature. Reply with the reading and result, then verify it holds through the next half hour.

Review the urgent lost-item report in the laundry SMS thread and match the sender to Contacts. Apply Lost Item Laundry Policy.csv from the shared folder immediately, then reply with the dryer outcome and reason.

input_instruction: Prepare laundry order CARE-510. Read the garment label photo on the first phone and Laundry care map.csv on the second, start the matching washer cycle, then complete Laundry Order Form.html in the shared folder and save it as Completed Laundry Order.html.

The linen pickup is approaching. Use the fabric label photo, the pickup event, and Dryer Cycle Matrix.csv in the shared folder to choose and start the dryer cycle. Complete the existing Linen dryer cycle task with the chosen cycle and pickup time.

Prepare the guest room from the preference card in Markor and Guest Scene Preferences.xlsx in the shared folder. Schedule the scene for the booking time, then use the host contact on the other phone to send a concise confirmation with the room and time.

Work through the Room-color batch in Tasks. The requested brightnesses are there; the owner restrictions are in Room Lighting Authority.md, and the handling rule is in Room Lighting Authorization.csv in the shared folder. Apply only the authorized immediate change and complete the task with what was applied, protected, or left for review.

Triage the current inspection request. The inspector's message identifies the condition, inspection.csv in Downloads says which ticket is active, and Inspection Response Rules.json in the shared folder defines the live-reading threshold and response. Apply only the active immediate response; do not create a plan.

Cooking left visible smoke in the kitchen. Use the photo, the Cooking cleanup event, and Kitchen Air Response.pdf in the shared folder to apply the immediate purifier response and its two follow-up stages. Complete the existing Kitchen smoke follow-up task with all three stages and times.

Please quiet the appliance that exceeds the evening limit without interrupting the normal laundry run. Compare Noise Survey.md with Quiet Appliance Triage.xlsx in the shared folder, act immediately, and complete the existing Quiet request task with the outcome.

Handle the robot fault recorded in Markor using Robot Fault Matrix.csv in the shared folder. Apply its immediate Home response, then look up the matching service contact on the other phone and send the fault code and outcome.

Review the two observations in Air Inspection Notes.md, use manifest.csv on the other phone to identify the active one, and apply the matching rule from Air Inspection Rules.xlsx in the shared folder. Leave the held room unchanged and create no delayed plan.

Handle bathroom incident B-902 from the message on the first phone. Use Moisture Incident Policy.pdf in the shared folder and the live Home reading for the response, then create and complete a Bathroom leak recheck task on the second phone with the case, room, and response.

The bedroom's older night plan is recorded in Markor, and a newer household message is waiting on the other phone. Use Night Plan Precedence.pdf in the shared folder to reconcile them, replace the Home plan when authorized, and reply with the resulting plan time.

Service the purifier identified by the Markor nameplate. Use Purifier Asset Register.csv in the shared folder for its allowed setting, make the immediate Home adjustment, then use the Asset Desk contact on the other phone to report the serial and resulting powered setting.

The cleaning photo may be stale. Use the live living-room occupancy and Occupied Room Cleaning Policy.pdf in the shared folder to decide the existing Cleaning request. If it cannot be done, record the reason in the Home system and complete the task with the decision; leave the robot and its future plans unchanged.

The robot is due for a warranty inspection. Follow the request in Tasks and Robot Warranty Procedure.docx in the shared folder, return the robot to its dock, and leave the technician a concise Markor handoff named Robot Warranty Handoff with the case, dock status, and live battery reading.

There is post-cleanup moisture in the bathroom, but the bedroom humidifier supports a medical comfort plan. Read the protection note in Markor, the homeowner's message on the other phone, and Medical Humidity Exceptions.pdf in the shared folder. Apply only the authorized immediate response and leave the protected device and future plans alone.

Prepare the evening equipment handover without changing Home. Handover Scope.md names the devices, the existing Tasks item explains the request, and Handover Recipients.txt in the shared folder gives the email details. Record each live state in Evening Equipment Handover.odt in the shared folder and draft the same concise handover in Thunderbird using the listed recipient and subject.

Let the current Air K-3 purifier run finish safely. Use the 28-minute Clock timer, Air Jobs.csv on the other phone, the live air reading, and Air Job Timer Policy.pdf in the shared folder to schedule the policy-defined finish. Do not change the purifier before the timer expires.

The Bathroom Dry task still describes an older shutoff, but Clock has the current drying timer. Follow Drying Plan Replacement Policy.html in the shared folder to replace the Home shutoff without changing the dehumidifier early, then complete the task with the timer duration and revised shutoff time.

Vacuum V-4 has a cleanup workflow in Home. Compare its timer mapping in cleaning-timers.csv on the second phone with Clock on the first phone, then follow Cleanup Policy.pdf in the Shared/Cleanup folder. Resolve the stale workflow and complete the existing Tasks item with the decision and reason.

The laundry approval workbook in the Shared/Laundry folder identifies one approved batch. Match that batch to batches.csv on the second phone and the available timers in Clock on the first phone. Schedule only its dryer follow-up in Home, then complete the existing Approved dryer follow-up task with the batch, cycle, and time.

Quiet Clean is running in the living room. Use its Clock timer, the battery rule in vacuum-end.csv on the second phone, the live Home battery, and the session map in Shared/Quiet Clean to choose the correct end action. Schedule it and complete the Quiet Clean handoff task with the battery, room, action, and time.

A heat complaint arrived by SMS on the first phone. Use the room comfort band on the second phone and Cooling Review.pdf in Shared/Cooling to respond to the live Home reading. Apply the supported cooling response, set its review timer, and reply with the room, reading, setting, and review interval.

The Bedroom Humidity task on the first phone identifies the request. Compare its live Home humidity with the target range on the second phone and the response matrix in Shared/Humidity. Apply the correct humidifier level, schedule its policy-defined stop, set the review timer, and complete the task with the setting and stop time.

A personal away timer on the first phone conflicts with an approved leave event on the second phone. Use Away Priority.pdf in Shared/Away to decide which source governs Home. Replace only the stale away routine, and leave a concise Markor note named Away source decision for the house sitter with the selected source and final time.

Cooking C-5 is in Broccoli on the second phone and has a matching Clock timer on the first. Use its smoke class with Kitchen Air Stages.csv in Shared/Cooking to protect the kitchen during and after cooking. Apply the stages in Home and complete the Cooking C-5 air stages task with the three outcomes and times.

The Air Review timer is nearly finished and the matching task is on the second phone. Use the live kitchen air reading and the handoff template in Shared/Air Review to decide whether the review closes or continues. Set the next timer if needed, complete the task, and save the filled ODT as Air Review Handoff.odt in the separate shared Air Review folder without changing Home.

The first phone has the current shower timer, the second phone maps it to a shower and gives the start offset and run length, and Old Shower Plan.xlsx in Shared/Shower shows the plan being replaced. Update only that bathroom dehumidifier plan in Home.

The first phone has timers for Quiet Session and Cleaning Window, while the approved Cleaning Window task is on the second phone. Use Quiet Conflict.pdf in Shared/Quiet Hours to resolve the overlap. Leave the protected quiet period undisturbed, remove any conflicting cleaning plan, and complete the task with the decision and next step.

Reconcile the rooms shown on the floor plan in Gallery with expected-rooms.csv on the second phone and the live rooms in Home. Use the workbook template in Shared/Room Reconciliation, and save the completed workbook as Room Reconciliation.xlsx in the shared Room Reconciliation folder. Mark every required room present or missing and list any extra Home room.

Prepare the device inventory requested in the Room inventory scope task. Use Contacts on the second phone to assign each scoped room to its owner, read the current devices from Home, and use the CSV template in Shared/Device Inventory. Save exactly one record per scoped device as Device Inventory.csv in the shared Device Inventory folder.

Prepare the Night Handover scheduled in Calendar for the duty contact on the second phone. Use the template in Shared/Night Handover and the live Home devices and active plans. Without changing Home, save Night Handover.docx in the shared Night Handover folder and draft an email to the duty contact with subject Night handover, attaching the document.

Audit the live bedroom humidity, kitchen PM2.5, and study brightness against thresholds.csv on the first phone and the auto-fix matrix in Shared/Environment Audit. Create Tasks items only for readings that need manual review, titling each one "Manual review: <room> <metric>", and complete the workbook as Environment Audit.xlsx in the shared Environment Audit folder. Do not alter Home or create Home plans.

Process the four requests in requests.csv on the first phone using the priorities in the Capability request task and the supported-command matrix in Shared/Capability Review. Execute only the highest-priority request that Home actually supports, then complete the task with every request's disposition. Do not change or schedule any rejected target.

Complete the Lighting Review event in Calendar using the attribute request on the second phone, the threshold policy in Shared/Lighting Review, and the live Home value. Append the device, actual value, threshold comparison, and status to the existing event description without changing Home or creating a plan.

Audit active Home schedules for the devices listed on the second phone during the Schedule Audit window in Calendar. Use the workbook template in Shared/Schedule Audit, record only active schedules inside the window, and save Schedule Audit.xlsx in the shared Schedule Audit folder. This is an observation audit: preserve the devices and every existing plan.

Review the Home workflow categories listed in the task on the second phone. Use workflow-categories.csv on the first phone and the conflict rules in Shared/Workflow Audit, then save Workflow Audit.odt in the shared Workflow Audit folder and complete the task with the conflict finding. Preserve every workflow and current device state.

The first phone has the desired Night Mode definition, the second phone identifies the automation owner, and Fault Review.html in Shared/Workflow Repair shows the failed Home item and a similar active routine. Repair only Night Mode, submit the fault form, and text the owner with the repaired time and the routine that remained active.

Prepare the study for the Reading request in Tasks. Use lighting.csv on the second phone, the light-selection matrix in Shared/Reading Light, and the live Home capabilities to choose the supported study light. Apply the requested level now, keep the unsuitable light unchanged, create no plan, and complete the task with both outcomes.

Please prepare the climate-capability review for the rooms listed in rooms.csv on the first phone. Match each room to its owner in Contacts on the other phone, follow Capability Rules.txt in the shared Climate Capability folder, and check the live SmartHome inventory. Save the review as Climate Capability Review.csv in that folder, text the owners who need a climate-capability follow-up, and leave SmartHome unchanged.

I need a current equipment handover before the Home Handover calendar event. Use the three checklist items on the other phone and live SmartHome state to complete the blank Lifecycle Handover.xlsx template in the shared Home Handover folder. Save the completed copy there as Home Handover Report.xlsx, including each item's current state and next step, without changing any equipment or creating plans.

Before the Quiet Window on the first phone, identify the highest-risk scheduled cleaning using live SmartHome occupancy and Quiet Window Risk Policy.pdf in the shared Quiet Window Review folder. Use Contacts on the other phone to notify that room's owner with the room and run time. Leave all SmartHome devices and plans unchanged.

Please finish the approved Comfort C-9 job. The request is in comfort-request.txt on the first phone, its approval and context are in Tasks on the other phone, and Comfort Fallback Policy.pdf is in the shared Comfort Fallback folder. Check which living-room lighting capability SmartHome actually has, apply the matching approved fallback, and complete the task with a concise note describing what was applied.

Set up tonight's SmartHome bedroom climate plan from the Sleep event on the first phone, the Wake alarm on the other phone, and Overnight Climate Rules.xlsx in the shared Overnight Climate folder. Update the Sleep event description with the two planned times and settings, and leave the air conditioner unchanged until the plan runs.

Prepare the SmartHome guest room for Lina's visit using the visit event on the first phone, Lina's temperature preference and number in Contacts on the other phone, and Guest Heating Policy.pdf in the shared Guest Heating folder. Schedule the appropriate preheat and departure reset, text Lina the plan, and do not change the heater before the plan runs.

Bring the SmartHome bedroom into the humidity range in bedroom-humidity.txt on the first phone before bedtime. The Bedroom Comfort task on the other phone gives the handoff context, and Humidifier Run Rules.csv is in the shared Bedroom Humidity folder. Use the live reading to choose the run, schedule its shutoff, and complete the task with the reading, setting, and shutoff time.

Please handle the bathroom dampness message on the first phone. Use the staged thresholds in drying-stages.csv on the other phone, the live SmartHome bathroom humidity, and Drying Safety Policy.pdf in the shared Bathroom Drying folder. Start the safe drying sequence, schedule its later stages, and reply with the reading and complete plan.

Set up SmartHome kitchen air recovery for tonight's cooking session. Use the recipe on the first phone to judge its smoke profile, the Cooking event on the other phone for timing, and Kitchen Air Recovery.xlsx in the shared Kitchen Air folder for the matching stages. Schedule the stages, leave the purifier unchanged until they begin, and add a Kitchen air review task for the final review time.

Set up the SmartHome study for the reading preparation in Tasks. Use the daylight target file on the first phone, the live study brightness, and Daylight Adjustment Policy.pdf in the shared Study Daylight folder to choose the first approved adjustment. Apply it now, avoid an unnecessary electric-light change or future plan, and complete the task with the adjustment and resulting reading.

Reduce the single most important SmartHome night-light overage. The Night light limit note on the first phone sets the limit and is also the night-shift handoff; protected-rooms.txt on the other phone lists rooms that must not change; Night Light Ranking.xlsx is in the shared Night Lighting folder. Use the survey rows and live devices to make one immediate adjustment, then add the selected room and setting to the note. Do not change other lights or create plans.

Protect tonight's SmartHome laundry quiet hours without interrupting the washer. The Quiet Hours event gives the boundary, dryer-rule.txt on the other phone gives the load owner's interruption permission, and Laundry Noise Policy.xlsx is in the shared Laundry Noise folder. Compare the live dryer time remaining with the window, take the required immediate action, and do not create a later plan.

Keep the SmartHome living room quiet for the upcoming video meeting. Use the event on the first phone, the Cleaning In Progress task on the other phone, and Meeting Noise Policy.pdf in the shared Meeting Noise folder to decide how to handle the live vacuum. Apply the immediate action, complete the task with a concise outcome, and do not add an automatic resume plan.

Run the approved SmartHome Deep Clean High request on the first phone without intruding on Quiet Hours on the other phone. Use the live vacuum battery and Deep Clean Window Rules.csv in the shared Deep Clean folder to decide whether it can start now and when it must dock. Complete the task with the start and dock times.

Please handle the two rooms in the pending Room energy review. The room list is in energy.csv on the first phone, the ticket notes define the approved scope, and Energy Branches.xlsx is in the shared Room Energy folder. Use the live occupancy and brightness to apply the appropriate immediate setting in each room, then complete the ticket with both outcomes. Do not create future plans.

Please complete the SmartHome Bedroom Comfort request in Tasks. The requested humidity is in comfort-request.csv on the first phone, and Air-Conditioner Modes.pdf in the shared Bedroom Comfort folder explains which supported device and mode to use. Apply the supported immediate setting, leave an unsuitable fallback alone, and record the decision in the existing task.

Prepare the SmartHome guest room for Nora's arrival without adding purifier noise. Her Contacts card records the comfort preference, the arrival is on the second phone's calendar, and Guest Preheat Rules.xlsx in the shared Guest Preheat folder explains when to begin. Schedule the approved preheat, leave both devices unchanged for now, and text Nora a concise confirmation.

Set up the SmartHome bedroom air plan for tonight's Sleep event. The target is in the Markor note named Air target, and Night Air Stages.xlsx in the shared Night Air folder defines the treatment stages around the event. Create the complete future plan without changing the purifier now, update the note with the stage summary, and make sure the treatment reaches its intended result before shutoff.

Please triage the three SmartHome rooms in thresholds.csv on the first phone. Room Risk Model.xlsx in the shared Room Triage folder explains how to rank the live readings, and Contacts on the second phone identifies each room's owner. Handle only the highest-risk room now, notify its owner with the reading and action, and leave the other rooms' equipment alone.

Schedule the two approved SmartHome room requests in Tasks on the first phone. Their target values and timing are in targets.csv on the second phone, and Plan Semantics.txt in the shared Room Plans folder explains how start, stop, and verification rows map to Home actions. Create the complete plans without changing either device now, then complete both Tasks with concise schedule summaries.

An Owner message on the first phone asks for a living-room climate change and gives the profile to use; the matching Contacts entry on the second phone confirms that sender's authority. Apply the profile from Climate Modes.xlsx in the Shared/Climate folder, then reply with the final living-room setting.

The first phone has bedroom_request.csv for a damp-bedroom service request, and the second phone has the matching Bedroom comfort follow-up task. Use Bedroom Comfort Profiles.pdf in the Shared/Bedroom Comfort folder to choose the approved response, apply it in Home, complete the task, and leave a concise maintenance handoff in Bedroom Comfort Handoff.txt in that same shared folder.

Prepare the guest room for Priya without changing it early. Her Contacts entry has the daylight profile, her arrival is in Calendar, and Daylight Profiles.csv is in the Shared/Guest Daylight folder. Schedule the profile at its arrival-relative lead time and text Priya the planned curtain setting and time.

Set up the study's two-stage daylight preparation without moving the curtain early. Work Start in Calendar supplies the anchor time, curtain-stages.csv on the other phone supplies the stage offsets, and Daylight Sequence.xlsx in the Shared/Study Daylight folder supplies each stage's curtain opening. Schedule both stages and complete the Study daylight task with the final plan.

Handle laundry order ORD-880 using the garment care label in Gallery and wash-map.csv on the other phone. The order form is Laundry Order.html in the Shared/Laundry folder. Start the matching washer cycle without changing the dryer, then submit the completed order form.

An Owner message reports incident L-246 and gives the equipment instruction. Use Emergency Incident Template.docx in the Shared/Incidents folder to document the response, carry out the requested Home action, and reply with the result. Save the completed report there as Emergency Incident L-246.docx.

Choose a dryer cycle for the Dryer Job on the first phone that finishes before the Laundry pickup deadline on the second phone, using Dryer Options.xlsx in the Shared/Laundry Dispatch folder. Start that cycle, then save Dryer Decision.xlsx in the same folder with one row for the job, selected cycle, and deadline basis.

Apply the household quiet-hours appliance policy when the Calendar event begins. dryer_rule.csv on the second phone identifies the applicable quiet profile, and Quiet Appliance Worksheet.xlsx is in the Shared/Quiet Hours folder. Use the live appliance state to carry out only the profile-required change.

Handle the Living Clean High request on the first phone. vacuum_policy.csv on the other phone maps its ticket and cleaning profile, while Robot Approval.html in the Shared/Robot Cleaning folder contains the final eligibility rule. If the live room and robot qualify, start cleaning, submit the approval page, and update the task with the outcome.

Protect the living-room meeting shown in Calendar from robot noise. The Robot cleaning task identifies the current job, and Robot Pause Policy.pdf in the Shared/Meeting Protection folder gives the handling rule. Apply the rule in Home and update the task with the outcome.

input_instruction: Use the office purifier photo, its live room conditions and Purifier Maintenance Policy.md in the shared folder to apply the correct maintenance setting now. Do not create a future plan.

Please review the quiet-hours notice in Gallery, the active kids-room vacuum plan, and Quiet Hours Schedule Policy.md in the shared folder. Remove the conflicting future cleaning plan without changing the vacuum now.

The entry robot has a dock-obstruction photo in Gallery and a future cleaning plan in Home. Use Robot Recovery Policy.md in the shared folder to recover it safely and remove any plan that would send it out again.

Compare the two hallway photos in Gallery using Hallway Evidence Guide.md in the shared folder and the live hallway state. Record the maintenance decision in a Markor note named Hallway review; do not change Home unless the current evidence actually calls for it.

Please use the live nursery humidity, the existing Nursery Wake alarm, and Nursery Humidity Window.md in the shared folder to set up the appropriate future treatment. Complete the existing Nursery humidity task with the reading, treatment window, level, and follow-up checkpoint.

Please prepare the facilities entry audit selected by manifest.csv in Android Files. Use the entry-panel photo in Gallery, the live Home state, and Entry Audit Rules.pdf in the shared folder, then save Entry Audit.zip in the shared folder. This is an observation-only audit.

Please reconcile the existing Return home R-E2 task with the installed home favorites and Return Route Index.csv in the shared folder. Set up the matching future SmartHome arrival scene and complete the task with the matching entrance and preparation time.

Please prepare Lina's guest-room arrival using her Contacts note, the installed accessible entrance favorite, and Guest Arrival Policy.md in the shared folder. Schedule the matching future SmartHome scene and send Lina a concise confirmation with the entrance, preparation time, and comfort settings.

Please use the departure event, its matching navigation favorite, and Away Destination Map.csv in the shared folder to prepare the appropriate future SmartHome scene. Record the destination, run time, mode, and effects in a Markor note named Away summary.

Please use the Leave for airport alarm, the matching navigation favorite, and Airport Departure Policy.pdf in the shared folder to prepare the cross-midnight SmartHome protection plan. Add a Tasks review named Airport home review with the derived protection time and review deadline.

The living-room robot vacuum needs service. Choose an open specialist by checking the saved OsmAnd places against Robot Service Directory.csv in the shared folder, then create a pending Tasks item titled Robot vacuum service with the selected center and the vacuum's current battery reading.

Prepare the guest room for the Guest arrival event. Match its location to the saved OsmAnd places and follow Guest Arrival Guide.xlsx in the shared folder; set up the resulting Home preparation without changing the room early.

Resolve the existing Guest Entrance C prep task using the saved OsmAnd entrances and Guest Entry Policy.pdf in the shared folder. If the requested entrance is unavailable, do not substitute another location: update the task with the reason and record the request as infeasible in Home.

Reconcile the Return Home event, the saved OsmAnd destination, and Return Plan Policy.pdf in the shared folder with Home's current future plans. Remove only the obsolete arrival preparation and preserve the unrelated night plan.

Prepare the entry for the owner's rainy arrival. Use the owner's SMS, the saved OsmAnd entrance, the live entry humidity, and Rainy Arrival Response.csv in the shared folder to schedule the response, then reply with the entrance and the planned start and end times.

Set up today's departure and return scenes from the Office departure and Return Home East events. Confirm each event location against the saved OsmAnd places and follow Day Scene Guide.xlsx in the shared folder, without changing the rooms early.

Plan the kitchen air recovery for the Crispy Stir Fry recipe and Dinner prep event using the live kitchen reading and Cooking Air Recovery.csv in the shared folder. Update the existing Kitchen air review task with the three stage times and the follow-up checkpoint; do not change the purifier early.

Set the dining room for the Chilled Tomato Salad dinner using the recipe, the live dining and kitchen air readings, and Low Emission Dinner Guide.pdf in the shared folder. Apply only the immediate lighting called for by the guide and leave air equipment alone.

Prepare the kitchen around the Breakfast alarm by classifying the Egg Breakfast recipe with Breakfast Prep Guide.md in the shared folder. Schedule the resulting light and purifier stages, and update the existing Breakfast prep task with their times without changing the kitchen early.

Prepare Maya's dinner accommodation by combining the guest dinner recipe with Maya Dinner Guest's saved contact preference and Guest Dinner Accommodation Guide.md in the shared folder. Schedule the matching Home scene and text Maya the time and settings.

The dinner recipe has changed. Reconcile Fry Dinner Update, the Cook dinner event, Home's existing kitchen-air plan, and Recipe Change Air Policy.csv in the shared folder. Replace only the obsolete plan with the policy-defined response and do not change the purifier early.

Match the recipe code in the existing `Dinner scene request` Task with the Broccoli recipe and `/tmp/home_ops/service-notes/source/index.csv`. Schedule the mapped SmartHome cooking scene, then complete that original Task—do not create a duplicate—and update its note with the matched recipe, the scheduled scene time, and that the scene has been scheduled.

Resolve the existing Dinner R-11 prep task by checking the Broccoli recipes against Missing Recipe Policy.pdf in the shared folder. If the exact recipe details are unavailable, do not invent an air plan: update the task with the reason and record the request as infeasible in Home.

Plan the kitchen air stages for Recipe C-5 Fry around the Cooking C-5 calendar window using Cooking Window Air Policy.csv in the shared folder. Complete the existing Cooking C-5 air stages task with the derived stage times and keep the purifier unchanged until the first stage.

Set the dining-room lighting for the Formal Dinner recipe using the live Home device capabilities and Dinner Lighting Guide.pdf in the shared folder. Apply the guide's immediate setting to the correct light without substituting the basic light or creating a future plan.

Set up the kitchen air response for the dinner recipe using Kitchen Air Governance.txt in the shared folder. Schedule the matching three-stage Home plan, and create Kitchen Air Response Plan.pdf in the shared folder for facilities with the selected recipe profile and all three stage times.

Prepare the office for the focus session described in focus-session.csv in Files. Use the playlist prepared in Retro Music and Focus Scene Matrix.md in the shared folder to replace the conflicting vacuum plan, then complete the existing Deep work scene task with the resulting preparation details.

Prepare the nursery for the Nap alarm using the playlist in Retro Music, Home's existing vacuum plan, and Nap Scene Rules.csv in the shared folder. Replace the noisy plan with the derived nap scene and complete the existing Nap scene task with the preparation and stop times.

Set up the dining-room atmosphere for the Dinner calendar event using the playlist prepared in Retro Music and Dinner Scene Guide.md in the shared folder. Schedule the selected scene without changing the dining room early.

Resolve tonight's quiet-hours conflict using the Kids sleep alarm, the Evening household note in Markor, Home's current plans, and Evening Quiet Policy.pdf in the shared folder. Remove the conflicting party plan and retain only the policy-defined bedtime preparation without changing devices early.

Replace the old 20:00 living-room party scene using the playlist prepared in Retro Music, the playlist-change note in Files, and Music Scene Matrix.csv in the shared folder. Keep the existing time, schedule only the selected replacement scene, and leave the room unchanged until then.

Mira's Contacts entry identifies the requested playlist, and Retro Music contains it. Use Guest Audio Scene Policy.csv in the shared folder to prepare the matching low-glare living-room scene in SmartHome and text Mira a concise confirmation.

For the meditation block in Calendar, use the available Retro Music playlist and Meditation Room Policy.csv in the shared folder to quiet the living room in SmartHome. Complete the existing Meditation room task with the immediate settings and the light-restoration time.

The Nursery Calm request in Tasks specifies the only acceptable playlist. Check Retro Music and Missing Playlist Procedure.md in the shared folder; if the request cannot be fulfilled, leave the task open with a concise reason and record the infeasible request in SmartHome without substituting another playlist.

Calendar identifies tonight's wind-down block, while Android Files names the approved playlist and Retro Music confirms it is available. Apply the matching immediate living-room response from Wind-Down Scene Policy.csv in the shared folder, then complete the existing Wind Down room task with the outcome.
Android Files contains the office scene request, and Retro Music contains the referenced playlist. Use Office Focus Scene Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule the matching SmartHome scene.
Use the Workday alarm in Clock and Morning Routine Policy.csv in the shared folder to prepare the bedroom in SmartHome. Complete the existing Workday morning task with the curtain and light times.

Clock has the Nap alarm and Markor has the latest nursery humidity reading. Use Nursery Humidity Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule the appropriate SmartHome treatment, then complete the existing Nursery humidity task with the reading, level, and treatment window.

Clock has the active cooking timer and Broccoli has the recipe's ventilation note. Use Cooking Ventilation Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule the matching kitchen purifier stages in SmartHome, then complete the existing Cooking C-5 task with the stage times.

The Bathroom Dry task contains the old shutoff, while Clock has the approved replacement timer. Use Bathroom Drying Revision Policy.csv in the shared folder to replace the old SmartHome plan, then complete the existing task with the revised shutoff.

Android Files shows whether Travel Day is enabled. Apply Travel Day Schedule Policy.pdf from the shared folder to the existing SmartHome morning plans, and write a concise Markor handoff named Travel Day cleanup.md describing what was cancelled and what remains.

Android Files contains the arrival booking's host code. Match it to Guest Wake Directory.xlsx in the shared folder and the current Clock alarms, schedule the corresponding guest-room curtain preparation in SmartHome, and complete the existing H-204 guest wake task with the alarm and preparation times.

Calendar has the approved departure update and Clock has the older departure alarm. Use Departure Lighting Policy.csv in the shared folder to replace the linked SmartHome lighting plans, and write Departure update.md in Markor with the governing departure, preparation time, and replaced plans.

Android Files names the requested overnight pathway profile, and Clock has its Night Walk alarm. Use Night Walk Lighting Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule the matching hallway lighting in SmartHome.

Android Files identifies the Clock timer required by the existing Vacuum V-4 cleanup workflow. Apply Vacuum Timer Cleanup Policy.pdf from the shared folder; if that exact timer is absent, cancel the linked SmartHome workflow and complete the existing cleanup task with the reason.

Guest Rowan's Contacts note has the comfort profile, and Clock has the matching wake alarm. Use Guest Comfort Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule the corresponding SmartHome warm-up and humidity treatment.

Use the nursery's live occupancy in SmartHome and Nursery Quiet Policy.csv in the shared folder to apply the correct quiet branch now. Complete the existing Nursery Quiet Check task with the selected branch, immediate settings, and disposition of the old vacuum plan.

The Owner's SMS gives the arrival time. Use the live entry humidity in SmartHome and Arrival Moisture Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule entry preparation, then reply with the resulting window and equipment settings.

Android Files contains the shift checklist. Use Hallway Audit Policy.pdf in the shared folder and the live SmartHome state to prepare the audit-only handoff Hallway Night Audit.md in the shared folder. Record the current hallway reading, light state, and next active light plan without changing Home.

Use the Office review event in Calendar, the live office equipment in SmartHome, and Office Meeting Preparation Policy.csv in the shared folder to schedule the supported meeting preparation. Update the event description with a concise summary of the preparation time and settings.

Calendar has the kids' sleep block and Tasks has an overlapping cleaning request. Apply Kids Room Priority Policy.pdf from the shared folder to SmartHome, then complete the existing Kids room cleaning task with the governing priority, quiet-scene time, and cleaning-plan disposition.
Android Files has the dinner checklist. Use Dinner Scene Matrix.xlsx in the shared folder and the live Home state to apply the matching dining-room scene without changing the kitchen purifier.

The nursery lead is in Contacts. Use Nursery Temperature Response.csv in the shared folder and the live nursery reading to apply the appropriate cooling response, then text the lead with the reading and result.

Simple Calendar Pro has today's departure and return appointments. Use Entry Day Policy.xlsx in the shared folder to create the matching entry-light plans, and summarize both scene times in a Markor note titled Entry day plan.
Clock has the Night Walk alarm. Use Night Walk Lighting Policy.csv in the shared folder and the live hallway occupancy to create the appropriate temporary light plan.

Use the existing Office device audit task and Office Audit Guide.md in the shared folder to inspect the live office devices and future plans without changing Home. Save the completed audit as Office Device Audit.md in the shared folder, then complete the task with the device and future-plan totals.

Complete the existing Bedroom Dry task using the live bedroom humidity and capabilities together with Bedroom Humidity Response.csv in the shared folder. Apply the supported response and record the reading and decision in the task.

Apply the guide to the live hallway brightness, schedule the resulting lighting, save a 640 by 360 Hallway Safety Card.png in the shared folder, and complete the task with the plan.

Review the live laundry state and its future follow-up without changing Home, complete the task with the findings, and save Laundry Handover.odt in the shared folder.

Simple SMS Messenger has a kitchen air complaint, and the shared folder contains Kitchen Air Response Policy.pdf. Use the live kitchen PM2.5 reading to apply the correct response, reply with the reading and action, and save Kitchen Air Incident.pdf in the shared folder.

Android Files contains manifest.csv for the current inspection set, and the shared folder contains Inspection Delivery Rules.pdf. Reconcile each manifest request against the live Home inventory without changing Home, then save Inspection Delivery.zip in the shared folder using the package contract in the rules.

Simple Calendar Pro has the revised office meeting, Android Files contains the approved scene settings, and the shared folder contains Meeting Plan Change.html. Replace the old Home preparation with the approved meeting preparation.

Simple Calendar Pro has the approved kids-room sleep window, Android Files identifies which policy revision is current, and the shared folder contains Night Policy Options.md. Resolve the conflicting Home plans and record the decision in the Markor note titled Night policy decision.

Audit the requested rooms against live Home state without changing Home, complete the task with the main findings, and save Room Audit Package.zip in the shared folder.

Clock has the Night Walk alarm, Tasks has the existing Night Walk hallway prep request, and the shared folder contains Night Walk Schedule Policy.csv. Replace the old Home hallway check with the policy-defined check and complete the task with the change.

If the request is authorized, cancel the matching future Home plan without changing the current purifier and reply with the outcome.

Contacts identifies the guest-room steward, Android Files has the failed-scene note, and the shared folder contains Guest Scene Repair Policy.csv. Rebuild the failed Home scene from that evidence and text the steward with the new timing.

Complete the existing Tasks item with the decision and reason, and record any infeasible request in Home without changing the purifier or its plans.

Simple Calendar Pro has the guest-room override, Android Files has the old-plan note and profile reference, and the shared folder contains Guest Climate Profiles.csv. Replace the old Home plan with the profile-selected plan at the event time, without changing the room early.

Process the change-set request in Simple SMS Messenger using Contacts to verify the sender, the exception note in Android Files, and Home Change Set.csv in the shared folder. Apply the permitted changes, replace the outdated entry-light plan, record any protected request as infeasible in Home, and reply with the outcome.

Use the existing Entry humidity E-20 task and Entry Humidity Incident Template.txt in the shared folder. Apply the template to the live Home humidity, complete the task with the reading and response timing, and save Entry Humidity Incident.pdf in the shared folder.
